items.raw_excerpt: The Singapore-exclusive merchandise includes cat wristlets, plush keychains, drinkware and blind box keychains.
items.summary_en: A new collection of Singapore-exclusive Mofusand and Starbucks merchandise will be available from August 25. The items include cat wristlets, plush keychains, drinkware, and blind box keychains. The collection is only available in Singapore.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents say they have seen groups of riders regularly race through the streets.
items.summary_en: People living in a neighbourhood say they feel scared because groups of illegal electric motorbike riders keep racing through the streets. Local residents want the problem to be stopped.
items.summary_ko: 지역 주민들은 불법 전동 바이크 무리가 길을 질주하는 모습을 자주 목격했다며 불안을 호소하고 있다. 주민들은 이 문제를 해결해 달라고 요구하고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Nursing graduates who have applied for hundreds of jobs and have not found work say it's devastating to hear there's a shortage of nurses.
items.summary_en: A nursing graduate has applied for hundreds of jobs but still cannot find work. This comes amid reports of a nursing shortage in New Zealand. The graduate says it is devastating to hear about shortages while struggling to get hired.
items.summary_ko: 간호학과 졸업생이 100개 이상의 직무에 지원했으나 취업에 실패했습니다. 뉴질랜드에서는 간호사 부족이 보도되고 있지만, 졸업생은 일자리를 찾지 못하고 있습니다. 이 상황은 졸업생에게 비극적이라고 합니다.
items.title_en: Nursing graduate applies for more than 100 jobs without success

items.summary_en: Enguera is a small village about an hour from Valencia that stays cool during intense summer heat waves. It sleeps at under 15 degrees thanks to its altitude and geography. The village also has the second longest suspension bridge in Spain.
items.summary_ko: enguera는 발렌시아에서 차로 한 시간 거리에 있는 작은 마을로, 여름 폭염 속에서도 서늘한 밤을 보낼 수 있습니다. 해발 고도와 지형 덕분에 기온이 15도 이하로 떨어집니다. 이 마을에는 스페인에서 두 번째로 긴 현수교도 있습니다.
items.title_en: A Village Near Valencia That Beats the Heat With Cool Nights Under 15 Degrees

items.raw_excerpt: Ugandan immigration authorities have returned the passports to four Taiwanese nationals after recently withholding their documents at Entebbe International Airport, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Thursday.
items.summary_en: Ugandan immigration officers returned passports to four people from Taiwan. The passports had been taken away at Entebbe International Airport. Taiwan's foreign ministry confirmed the return on Thursday.
items.summary_ko: 우간다 이민국 직원들이 대만인 4명의 여권을 돌려줬습니다. 이 여권은 엔테베 국제공항에서 압수당했었습니다. 대만 외교부는 목요일 반환을 확인했습니다.
items.title_en: Uganda gives back passports to four Taiwanese travelers
items.title_original: Uganda returns passports withheld from 4 Taiwanese: MOFA

items.raw_excerpt: Aug 20 : Former Japan international Kazuyoshi Miura became the oldest scorer in Emperor's Cup history on Wednesday when the 59-year-old netted two penalties in Fukushima United's 7-0 victory over amateur side Oyama Soccer Club.At 59 years, 5 months and 24 days, Miura surpassed the record held by former Japan
items.summary_en: Kazuyoshi Miura, 59, made Emperor's Cup history by becoming the oldest scorer. He scored two penalties for Fukushima United in a 7-0 win over amateur side Oyama Soccer Club. His record-breaking performance shows his enduring talent at an age when most players have retired.
items.summary_ko: 59세 카즈요시 미우라가 천황배에서 최연소 득점 기록을 세웠다. 그는 프ุ쿠시마 유나이티드의 7-0 승리에서 페널티 두 골을 넣었다. 대부분의 선수들이 은퇴할 나이에도 그의 뛰어난 기량은 계속되고 있다.
items.title_en: 59-year-old footballer becomes oldest scorer in Emperor's Cup
items.title_ko: 59세 축구 선수, 천황배 최연소 득점 기록 세워
items.title_original: Japan's Miura, 59, becomes oldest scorer in Emperor's Cup history

items.raw_excerpt: The vast majority of adults in Ireland (79%) are interested in investing in the Government's new planned Savings and Investment Account, research from the Banking & Payments Federation Ireland suggests.
items.summary_en: A survey by the Banking & Payments Federation Ireland found that 79% of adults are interested in the government's new planned Savings and Investment Account. The scheme aims to encourage more people to invest their money. The research highlights strong public interest in the new financial product.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드은행및결제연맹의 조사에 따르면, 아일랜드 성인의 79%가 정부가 새로 도입할 저축 및 투자 계좌에 관심이 있는 것으로 나타났다. 이번 제도는 더 많은 사람들의 투자를 장려하기 위해 마련되었다. 조사는 대중이 새로운 금융 상품에 대해 높은 관심을 가지고 있음을 보여준다.
items.title_en: 79% of adults interested in new savings scheme - research
items.title_ko: 신규 저축 상품에 관심 있는 성인 79% - 조사
items.title_original: 79% of adults interested in new savings scheme - research

items.raw_excerpt: A new station on the southeast end of the Taipei Metro Xinyi Line will open on Aug. 30, extending service 1.4 kilometers past the current terminal station, Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) said Thursday.
items.summary_en: A new station will open on the southeast end of the Taipei Metro Xinyi Line on August 30. The extension adds 1.4 kilometers of service past the current terminal. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an announced the opening date on Thursday.
items.summary_ko: 타이베이 지하철 신이선 동남쪽 끝에 새 역이 8월 30일 문을 연다. 이번 연장으로 기존 종착역에서 1.4킬로미터 구간이 추가된다. 쟝원안 타이베이 시장이 목요일 개통일을 발표했다.
items.title_en: New Taipei MRT station opens on Xinyi Line
items.title_ko: 타이베이 지하철 신이선에 새 역 8월 30일 개통
items.title_original: New station on Taipei MRT Red Line to open Aug. 30

items.raw_excerpt: New adult entertainment services including sex shops will be banned from operating in prominent locations across the Adelaide CBD and North Adelaide, but existing venues will be able to remain.
items.summary_en: New adult entertainment businesses will be banned from opening in prominent locations across Adelaide CBD and North Adelaide. Existing venues in these areas will be allowed to continue operating. The exclusion zones aim to keep adult businesses away from main shopping and residential areas.
items.summary_ko: 애들레이드 시내와 북애들레이드 지역의 주요 상권에 신규 성인 엔터테인먼트 업소의 입점이 금지됩니다. 다만 기존 업소는 계속 영업이 가능합니다. 이번 조치는 주요 쇼핑 및 주거 지역에서 성인 업소의 위치를 제한하기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: New exclusion zones for adult entertainment venues in Adelaide CBD
items.title_ko: 애들레이드 CBD 신규 성인 업소 운영 제한 구역 신설

items.raw_excerpt: Will you need a new Swedish passport next year? Police are urging people to apply early to beat the queues.
items.summary_en: Swedish police are asking people to renew their passports early next year. About 2.4 million passports will expire soon, which could cause long lines at offices.

items.title_en: Swedish Police Urge Early Passport Renewals as 2.4 Million Set to Expire
items.title_ko: 스웨덴 경찰, 여권 240만 개 만료 앞두고 조기 갱신 권고
